rationale: User requested multiple tests at once efficiently. Reused exact compiled-once original protected Go TLS, developer-gated NON-_test embedded Rust ScopedOwner M1/M3/M4 and actual Linux raw/TUN backend. Exercised three cipher suites across one baseline, configured 10ms and configured 150ms kernel qdisc functional scenario. No production capability advertising.

source_history.reason: New negative test incorrectly subtracted a LINK fragment header from ordinary unfragmented payload; expected 1356B ordinary packet rejection, but ordinary packets do not include LINK20 and 1356B was valid. Actual kernel delivered it. Test mistaken, not runtime authorization bypass. Exact failed run retained; never reported as passing.

source_history.fix: Source-checked ordinary LINK overhead: record framing=31, LINK20 ONLY for fragments; exact legal unfragmented payload IP 1400-31=1369. Go TLS sealer rejects 1370 IP before send. Separately inject valid-length TCP packet with 1401B MALFORMED ciphertext record (valid 1400B record plus appended byte): original M4/Linux raw ingress and original Rust M1/M3 reject, independent TUN application sees no redelivery in bounded 40ms. No Rust runtime/budget changes.

verification.same_artifact: Exactly one locked/pinned Go real TLS and original normal-built Rust developer-tagged library/test binary build, same-run manifest SHA checks and same-run consumer across three network cases.

scientific_limits: Correct ordinary LINK max is record_wire_limit - record_fixed=1369B; LINK_HEADER20 is charged only to fragments, not ordinary payload. The malformed 1401B raw record is NOT valid AEAD and is not called an authenticated beyond-budget packet; local Go sealer refuses such a record. The safety boundary tested is exact accepted max and rejection of non-emittable or malformed overlong wire.

No permanent product ABI enablement. This is opt-in developer m0_v4_embedded_go feature plus Go build tag, original pinned FakeTCP SYN test generated; real credential verification and kernel I/O performed inside isolated GitHub Actions namespace; default features=0.

Three two-packet per-direction test suites, no sustained 10Mbps throughput or actual RTT benchmark. 10/150ms are configured tc netem delays, not measured RTT; qdisc counters demonstrate real kernel traffic only.
The 40ms app negative-read timeout is a finite non-delivery observation per packet, not a full weak-network or sustained adversarial result.
1/5% actual tc loss, reorder, 300ms, veth, full protocol fragmentation/magic/MTU±1 on S2C, true externally held async M4 driver loan B04 and B01-B02 genuine install overlap NOT_RUN.
No physical machine, 500Mbps, measured throughput/CPU-s/p99 or real Windows/ARM native execution. GitHub API artifact digests are metadata receipts and were not rehashed after download.
next_action: Build one bounded low-rate multi-packet actual Go TLS→same Rust owner→real raw/TUN bidirectional test with actual elapsed time, accepted/lost/app-delivered counters and one controlled 1% netem loss case (no fake PASS for missing packets), reusing one compiled-once exact Actions SOURCE; then decide which M4 ownership capability is genuinely needed for B04.
